"We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

"When's the last time you really laughed?"

"Okay. We'll pick this up later."

"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

deathBeat: d18: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kavya Mejia is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d18: 🕯️ Kavya Mejia is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d18: The village's quarrel was with Kavya — and Kavya is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
recoverHome: d19: That night, they bring Kavya home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
vouch: d18: At the grave, Lena speaks for Jorge — "Kavya trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
